newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Nov 12.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories:

WASHINGTON - HFS Inc., the rapidly expanding New Jersey firm that owns Avis Inc., Century 21 Real Estate Corp., and Days Inn, said it will acquire PHH Corp., a company that provides employee relocation and other services, for $1.7 billion in stock.
WASHINGTON - A bidding war is underway in Texas that could help determine who will be the corporate welfare king.
MIAMI - A $1.65 billion merger announcement by drug wholesaler Bergen Brunswig Corp. and generic drug giant Ivax Corp., sent both stocks tumbling.
WASHINGTON - Americans spent almost $104 billion on liquor, beer and wine last year and the alcohol industry spent more than $1 billion in advertising.
